title: Delinquency and Charge-Off Points for Ridgeline Financing Accounts
content:
Two days-past-due points govern the status of a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account. They are the same on all six plans.

| Point | Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 12 | Ridgeline Same-As-Cash 18 | Ridgeline Zero-Interest Equal Pay 24 | Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 60 | Ridgeline Fixed-Rate 120 | Ridgeline Low-Payment 144 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days past due at which the account becomes delinquent and is reported to the credit bureaus | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Days past due at which the account is charged off and moved to collections | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |

- At 30 days past due a scheduled payment makes the account delinquent; credit bureau reporting begins from that point.
- At 120 days past due the account is charged off and moves to collections.
